description.value: Salish Sea Beach House is a B&B situated on Lochside Drive in Sidney, BC, directly alongside the Lochside Regional Trail — a primary cycling corridor on the Saanich Peninsula. The property overlooks Bazan Bay toward James Island and San Juan Island, with 10,000 sq ft of exclusive beachfront access for guests. Host Shelley offers a single 'Solaris Suite,' set within half an acre of English gardens with walking paths and mature Arbutus trees.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active B&B on Lochside Drive in Sidney, BC, with a 'Reserve Now' call-to-action, consistent with the OSM record. The site lists several nearby restaurants under 'Nearby Attractions,' supporting the 'Nearby evening food' amenity. However, the website contains no mention of bike storage, cycling facilities, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any other WWC-relevant amenities, so nearly all criteria remain null. Notably, Lochside Drive is part of the Lochside Regional Trail, a major cycling corridor, making this property geographically relevant to touring cyclists.
